Application Data.NAME: Sunny Steps Shoe Store
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunny Steps Shoe Store specializes in the retail sale of a wide variety of footwear, including casual shoes, athletic shoes, formal footwear, and children's shoes. We also offer on-site shoe repair services, focusing on minor repairs such as sole replacements, stitching, and polishing, all conducted in a well-maintained storefront located at 1234 Elm Street, Springfield, IL. Our shop adheres to local safety codes, and we prioritize maintaining a clean and safe environment for both customers and employees.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses were incurred on 07/15/2022 due to a minor slip and fall incident in the store, resulting in an amount of $1,000. The claim was settled and closed promptly. Additionally, on 02/10/2023, there was a minor equipment damage incident amounting to $500 caused by a malfunctioning sewing machine used for on-site repairs. This incident is currently under review but is not expected to affect future operations.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras installed, regular security patrols, and a locked display case for high-value items.

to local safety codes.

– Mobile shoe repair services that operate with properly insured commercial vehicles; these
must comply with geographic service area restrictions (see Industry-Specific Restric-
tions).

or liability claims, provided corrective measures have been implemented.
– Small-scale shoe repair operations that do not involve hazardous materials or high-risk
